summary: This note is a short Wikipedia-style biographical entry for Mary Cadorette, an American actress. It gives her full name, birth date, and her best-known role as flight attendant Vicky Bradford, John Ritter's live-in girlfriend, on the short-lived 1984 spin-off Three's a Crowd.
one_line: Mary Cadorette is an American actress known for playing Vicky Bradford on the 1984 spin-off Three's a Crowd.
